scope: Synthetic checks are not live reliability trials

cases.name: first-startup
cases.expected: Startup floor conditional; no digest establishes application.

cases.name: ordinary-continuation
cases.expected: Persistence retains still-current conventions; no frozen mutable state.

cases.name: material-change
cases.expected: New repository/activated owners remain unresolved obligations.

cases.name: specialized-owner-unknown
cases.expected: Conditional owner reads visible, not definitely active.

cases.name: live-trigger-summary
cases.expected: Mandatory source trigger and external current owner retained.

cases.name: partial-verification
cases.expected: Unknown result cannot yield readiness or complete contract.

cases.name: rejected-transport-alternative
cases.expected: Qualified available route remains recovery, no premature all-route failure.

cases.name: all-routes-unavailable
cases.expected: Stop affected conclusions and name exact gap.

cases.name: judgment-false
cases.expected: Repository work=false and material change=false do not prune any obligations.

cases.name: stale-context
cases.expected: Old context observation remains stale and non-pruning.

cases.name: omitted-unavailable
cases.expected: Unknown and unavailable remain distinct and visible.

cases.name: duplicate-conflict
cases.expected: Conflicting observations retained; no last-write-wins.

cases.name: forged-qualification
cases.expected: Resolution upgrade and fabricated evidence reference rejected.

cases.name: scope-freshness
cases.expected: Evidence mismatch cannot widen scope or prune.

cases.name: false-conjunct-proof
cases.expected: Qualified observed false conjunct excludes independently of judgment, with exact proof.

cases.name: required-inapplicable
cases.expected: Required rule retained despite independent false activation.

cases.name: judgment-all-paths
cases.expected: not/all/any, edges, failure, lifetime and completion never discharge judgment.

cases.name: external-closure
cases.expected: All adapters, interaction-mode and action-latch remain external; no complete startup.

cases.name: graph-retirement
cases.expected: Retired active references and meaningful cycles rejected; reference cycles accepted.

cases.name: action-definition
cases.expected: Changed action with stable rules yields definition event and declared fan-out.

cases.name: term-boundary
cases.expected: Imported term and boundary/evidence definition changes fan out; unrelated control unaffected.

cases.name: normative-context
cases.expected: Normative-to-context is removal; context-only and old/new deleted-reference impacts distinct.

cases.name: renderer-output-corruption
cases.expected: Dropped exception, changed modality, invented fallback, stale/hand-edit/missing/extra detected.

cases.name: authority-rehearsal
cases.expected: Forward, compiler/content rollback, inadequacy and reverse preserve one mock owner; stale/incomplete blocked.
